name: River Development Agent Production Execution Authority Operational Entry Integration
objective: Establish a deterministic, fail-closed, non-executing production integration boundary that consumes an already-valid DEV-323 production execution authority orchestration result and delegates its preserved requested mode and operation-execution authorization into the existing DEV-314 operational executor integration entry boundary without creating, upgrading, synthesizing, broadening, or executing authority.
requirements: Consume an existing DEV-323 production execution authority orchestration result.
Require DEV-323 to be readyForOperationalEntry before apply progression.
Preserve DEV-323 requested-mode and governed operation-execution authorization identity without alteration.
Delegate operational-entry admission exclusively to the existing DEV-314 establishOperationalExecutorIntegrationEntryFoundation boundary.
For dry-run, preserve DEV-314 non-mutating dry-run admission semantics.
For apply, require DEV-314 to independently confirm OPERATION_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED before admission.
Fail closed when DEV-323 is blocked, not ready, lacks usable authorization, or contains incompatible authority evidence.
Do not treat requested apply mode as authorization.
Do not create, upgrade, synthesize, infer, or broaden execution authorization.
Do not broaden approved execution scope.
Do not bypass DEV-314 operational executor entry policy.
Do not perform actual operational execution.
Do not modify production callers in this initial specification-only phase.
Return deterministic evidence describing DEV-324 operational-entry integration readiness and admission.
safetyInvariants: Requested apply mode is never authorization.
DEV-324 cannot broaden approved execution scope.
DEV-324 cannot bypass DEV-314 operational executor entry.
DEV-324 cannot independently admit unauthorized apply.
DEV-324 cannot independently execute repository mutation.
No repository mutation or external side effect occurs inside DEV-324.
outOfScope: Replacement or modification of DEV-314 operational executor entry.
Replacement or modification of DEV-319 authorization orchestration.
Replacement or modification of DEV-323 production authority orchestration.
Commit, push, deployment, network use, or secret access.
Creation or broadening of approved execution scope.
nextStep: Implement the narrow DEV-324 adapter and shared result/input contracts only within the evidence-approved paths; consume DEV-323, preserve its requested mode and authorization identity, delegate admission exclusively to DEV-314, remain non-executing, and add focused deterministic fail-closed tests before any production caller integration.
